reader.notes: A table is built from one element initializer repeated per occurrence (OccurrenceRunEmit.Array over ElementInit), and element access goes through CobolTable.At, so every clause of the entry is a property of the element type and holds for each occurrence. The one edition switch on the VALUE path concerns numeric-edited VALUE images, not per-occurrence application.
